kind: Sanitized public source evidence for read-only MyDITO account data; no private account capture

controlled_validation.manual_refresh_and_expiry_paths: Verified offline; not forced against the live account

facts.fact: Module +n12 exports I as its subscriber object getter and K as its user object getter. Account bridge invokes these original getters only inside the isolated page; it never reads browser storage/cookies or exports subscriber/session material.
Subscriber getter returns the direct site-owned subsInfo object. Share effects consume this getter's accNbr field; Home consumes its prodInstId field.

Login model's original subscriber getter uses GET /ecare/webs/subs/qrySubsDetail?prodInstIds=<userData.subsId>. Its result is a direct subscriber object, not a data envelope, before ordinary site storage installation.

Original loginSuccess installs userData, conditionally retrieves subscriber details, then enters /pto/home after consent. The application preserves this existing flow and invokes any missing read only after its existing authenticated proof.

Module 0WZ6 declares GET account/<acctId>/balance, POST common/configParam and POST balance/balInfo/glSumInfo. Home uses the latter two; no additional account balance getter is needed for Home's load presentation.
Home module G7HE declares POST /ecare/webs/balance/balInfo with its ordinary data object. home/getBalInfo submits {prodInstId}; response is a direct array.

home/glSumInfo submits {prodInstId} to the original summary getter and matches glId to the first configured generalData/allNetSMS/offNetSMS/onNetSMS/allNetVoice/offNetVoice/onNetVoice entry. No additive total is constructed.

home/getBalInfo treats numeric acctResId=1 as principalBook. Other nonzero numeric resource IDs become othersList, shown by Home as My Promo Details. These are returned balance-resource names, not established commercial offer names.

The official request client's desktop error handler returns to the sign-in route on HTTP401 or a PORTAL-SECURITY code. Its error handler can return false; a false value without route/security evidence is not independently sufficient to declare session expiry.
Original t3Un.a client owns credentials, anti-CSRF and request-signing interceptors. Account bridge reuses that client; it does not reconstruct signing, export tokens or make direct fetch calls.
The original request implementation supports timeout and ordinary fetch options. New reads are bounded with timeout and an application-owned AbortSignal.

Webpack4 bootstrap exposes window.webpackJsonp; queue entries register modules and execute entry IDs through the existing loader. The bridge adds one private entry to obtain original modules without loading protected Home/BaseLayout chunks.
window.g_umi contains its version only. DVA app uRV1 is closed over and does not export its store/getApp; the bridge does not guess a global store accessor.

Protected layout bootstrap retrieves common/configParam with configCode webs.ecare.usageGL, summary with subscriber prodInstId and account balance with defaultAcctId. Its mount additionally starts notification and tracking/UCC configuration requests, so the bridge leaves this chunk blocked.

Returned detail row fields rendered by Home are acctResName, expDate, formatRealBalance, formatRealBalanceUnitName, formatGrossBalance and formatGrossBalanceUnitName. unlimitedFlag=Y replaces the balance display with infinity. Raw balances only drive progress, not an invented displayed total.
Home consumes generalInfo, smsInfo, voiceInfo, othersList and principalBook. Fresh Home reads request configCode webs.ecare.usageGL then glSumInfo/getBalInfo using the same subscriber prodInstId.
Home labels principalBook as Load Balance and displays its currencySymbol (or the separate site currency config), formatRealBalance and expDate.

My Promo Details renders othersList resource names and per-row remaining/expiry. This is not proof of a commercial offer/plan name. Current Home never invokes its mapped but unused getOffidConfigParam action.

bridge_reads.query: Exact numeric prodInstIds obtained by the original user getter; only needed when subscriber details are missing

bridge_reads.body: The same original subscriber prodInstId, unchanged type

field_mappings.load_balance: balInfo row with numeric acctResId=1: formatRealBalance and returned currencySymbol only; never substitute an invented currency
field_mappings.data_remaining: Summary row whose glId matches config.generalData[0]: formatRealBalance and returned formatRealBalanceUnitName, or verified unlimitedFlag=Y
field_mappings.active_promos: Unverified commercial names remain unavailable. Official Home's returned My Promo Details resource rows are shown separately as reported buckets
field_mappings.expiry: PrincipalBook expDate; row expiry stays with each corresponding bucket
field_mappings.sms_allowance: Individually reported allNetSMS/offNetSMS/onNetSMS rows; no sum and no zero default
field_mappings.call_allowance: Individually reported allNetVoice/offNetVoice/onNetVoice rows; returned units only, no inferred minutes
field_mappings.data_buckets: All returned non-load balance-resource rows shown by MyDITO Home, preserving reported name/remaining/unit/expiry without assuming every resource is data
field_mappings.last_updated: Application UTC completion time of the successful fresh read; not a fabricated carrier-side timestamp

unused_offer_getter_limit: An unused home/getOffidConfigParam action accepts caller-supplied configParams and hisParams, queries packageHisPageList, then selects offerId matching the config response and orderStatusCode=300000. Current Home supplies no payload or display. Source does not establish the order-status meaning, active-now test, complete paging or current commercial offer-name schema; this getter is not enabled or called.
unknowns: Direct-object/direct-array schema and the recorded field presence passed one controlled live account read. Other accounts/builds may differ; public-source investigation itself made no authenticated requests.
Calendar timezone of returned text expDate and alternate account/FWA schemas remain unknown.
Resource bucket overlap/additivity is unverified; only returned values are shown and no detail sum is calculated.
Commercial active promo names and active-now order semantics are not established by the actual current Home source.
Actual session lifetime and remote server revocation remain unverified; existing official sign-in/session behavior is preserved.
